decisions.reason: A vertigo combination tablet close to the core offer and launched only in 2024 still has unresolved prospects and costs little to keep, so the option is worth holding.

Although this generic antidepressant is distant from the core and faces price pressure, its approval is a sunk cost and it was just launched with its own page, so it is too early for the uncertainty to have resolved against it.
A multi-strength combination antihypertensive close to the established portfolio has low carrying cost and growth potential, so keeping the option open is sensible.

The bone and joint supplement fits the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive self-care products and is cheap to maintain, but its weaker web presence suggests some risk that it gets trimmed among the firm's many options.
